page.layout: Running head at top across the page: "DE ANIM. INCESSU LIB." with page number 1351 at right. Two parallel text columns of Greek on the left page (left half, Greek with marginal section letters A–F at the column junction) and two columns of Latin on the right half; at the bottom of the right-hand block, the signature "Qqqq iiij". Marginal section letters A, B, C, D, E, F sit in the centre gutter between the Greek and Latin columns.

main_text.p: καὶ καθόλου δή, διὰ τὴν αἰτίαν τὰ μὲν ἄπο- Apluribus:& ad summam,quam ob causam ex animalium numero alia quidem pedibus carent, alia verò bipeda aut quadrupeda aut multipeda existant: & cur quaecunque illorum pedes habent, eos habeant pares: & omnino ex notae quibus mouentur, pares existunt. Praeter haec etiam quam ob causam homo & volucrum genus bipes, pisces verò pedibus carent. Et inflexus quidem crurum homo & volucris, cùm sint bipedes, contrarios habent. Homo nanque ad ambitum crus inflectit: volucris verò ad cauum: ipse quinetiam homo contrario ad seipsum modo crura inflectit & brachia. haec enim ad cauum, genua autem ad ambitum inflectit.
main_text.head: CAPVT II.
main_text.p: Perscrutationis autem principium est, supponentibus illa nobis quibus vti saepenumero in physico negotio soliti sumus, accipere scilicet ea quae in omnibus naturae operibus eodem se habent modo.
main_text.head: CAPVT III.
main_text.p: Is autem constitutis, quae deinceps sunt dicamus. Animalium profecto quaecunque

page.notes: The page is set in Greek and Latin in two columns; the Greek left-hand text is only partly legible in the scan and is given here in outline, and the Greek column (including the chapter heading "Κεφάλαιον β." and "Κεφάλαιον γ.") is not fully transcribed letter by letter. Marginal section letters A–F stand in the central gutter. Lines at the very end of the Latin columns are partly obscured by the page edge.
